summary: Backend regression + new endpoint coverage for BETZ P2 hardening (admin impersonation, demo-users, PUT /admin/users empty-body validation, /friends/request JSON body). All 38 pytest cases passing (24 prior regression + 14 new). Backend boots cleanly with JWT_SECRET in env (fail-fast path verified at code level).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.py:180 — DEMO_USER_EMAILS hardcoded. Consider sourcing from env or DB tag (e.g. user.is_demo flag) so ops can add demo accounts without code change.
admin_routes.py:206 — Impersonation user JWT TTL is 12h. Logged token is indistinguishable from a real login; consider adding `impersonated_by` claim and audit log entry for traceability.

admin_routes.py:151-169 — PUT /admin/users: `result.matched_count == 0` returns 404 AFTER validating non-empty body, which is correct order. But a successful no-op update (same value) still returns 200 — acceptable.

server.py:837-883 — /friends/request now validates self, existence, and duplicates. Good. Minor: notif `content` uses `current_user['name']` without null-guard; if name absent in DB, will KeyError. Low risk since register requires name.
server.py — file is 3080 lines; should be split into routers (auth, bets, friends, messages, chat, admin) per the >700-line guideline.
admin_routes.py:441 — /admin/demo/reset wipes ALL users including admin-created/real users. Powerful destructive endpoint — confirm intentional or restrict further.
